title: Market-state directional benchmark
claim: Causal own-market and basket state may improve future return loss at one frozen horizon over zero, mean, persistence, and reversal controls.
mechanism: Price, volume, and volatility state may summarize conditional return dynamics; the sign and horizon are not presumed.
target: Outright or training-only factor-residual log return selected from the locked target family.
horizon: One of 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 12h, 1d, 3d, or 7d, selected in development and frozen.
informationSet: Point-in-time candles, volume, trade count, realized variance, and basket controls
primaryBaseline: Strongest frozen zero, mean, persistence, reversal, or market-only control

evidence.summary: The same 15m outright-return ExtraTrees specification had positive aggregate development loss differences in baskets 4 and 6, but basket 6 was not finalized, its placebo was unavailable, basket 10 was untested, and no dependence-aware inference or economic evidence was produced.

nextAction: Keep V2 suspended. A smaller V3 requires a fresh reviewed lock, explicit family-wide inference, and outcomes not reused as confirmation; do not open the V2 confirmation ledger.
